info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Status API provides a comprehensive view of the current statuses of shipments within the logistics framework. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can efficiently monitor shipment progress and update stakeholders on status changes. Typical consumers include logistics managers, supply chain analysts, and customer service representatives who require real-time visibility into shipment operations. This API supports various integration scenarios that enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of shipments. It can be used to monitor shipment progress and ensure timely delivery.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters needed to retrieve the status of shipments. Ensure that you provide the necessary details in the request payload to receive accurate status information.

ListLogisticsShipmentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to shipments status.

ListLogisticsShipmentsStatusResponse_200.title: Shipment Status Response

status.description: Indicates if the shipment status retrieval was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the shipment status request.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the shipment status request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the shipment status.

ListLogisticsShipmentsStatusResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response format for retrieving the status of a shipment.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the shipment status request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the shipment status request was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the shipment status request was initiated automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema holds audit information related to the shipment status request.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
